purpose: Close the current source08 offline definition-bundle and runtime-plan gap without starting Java, exporting definitions, consuming entropy, allocating a D2 cell, or initializing a game.

phase_0_java_closure: Recover the exact Java executable path/version/vendor/architecture and binary SHA-256 recorded by the accepted source08 runtime receipt.
Independently bind those recorded identifiers to immutable Java distribution provenance. Do not substitute a current hosted-runner Java executable merely because version 21 matches.
If exact Java closure cannot be independently established, stop; no export is dispatched.
phase_1_runtime_restore: Reassemble only the already accepted source08 runtime archive bytes by exact SHA-256.
Restore the exact 56-entry ordered classpath from the preserved runtime audit.
Reject any missing, extra, reordered, mutated, symlinked, or shadowed runtime member before Java starts.
phase_2_offline_export: Run only the exact current source08 exporter/wrapper/getter/assembler identities bound above.
Load exactly the frozen 36 getter identities covering the 33-card first-cell main-deck union.
Produce an offline immutable definition bundle and complete receipt without reading official D2 seeds, allocation state, trial journals, or game outcomes.
Immediately hash and preserve the bundle plus ordered runtime/Java/source inputs.
phase_3_reload_only: In a separate no-game validation process using the same accepted Java/runtime closure, reload the exact emitted bundle.
Verify complete identity/count/source bindings and reject any dynamic fallback to repository card definitions.
phase_4_independent_audit: Audit original export/reload artifacts exactly once for Java/runtime/source binding, ZIP/CRC, freshness, definition counts and absence of entropy/game initialization.
Only a separately accepted audit may populate the final non-executing first-cell manifest.

fail_closed: Any null pre-dispatch binding blocks execution.
No mutable hosted-runner label or setup-java version string may stand in for exact Java byte provenance.
Any runtime/member/classpath drift blocks before Java starts.
Any seed/entropy/allocation/game access is a protocol violation and invalidates the attempt.
No automatic retry or replacement export after an original attempt.
